prompt: The principal ids of hr-agent/ are employees' email addresses. Make sure nobody who holds a trace or a log line can confirm who a user is by hashing a guessed email address. I'll provide any secret values myself; don't put secrets in the repository.

checks.why: PRINCIPAL_HASH_SALT (HMAC key of the hashed id) is a secret: add it to secrets.keys

checks.expr: all(k in get(data, 'secrets.keys', []) for k in ('OPENAI_API_KEY', 'JUDGE_API_KEY', 'POSTGRES_DSN', 'API_KEY', 'LANGSMITH_API_KEY'))

reference: Hashed principal ids are sha256 of the id unless PRINCIPAL_HASH_SALT is set (then HMAC-keyed); guessable ids such as emails need the salt. Add PRINCIPAL_HASH_SALT to `secrets.keys` in the manifest (never into values files), and tell the user to put a random value in each .env.<env> and run `graph-agents-cli secrets apply --env <env>`, then restart (changing the salt changes every hash).
